firstMessage.content: Has anyone run a ~30B mixture-of-experts base model on the 2xT4 setup within the 9-hour limit? Curious about practical numbers: load time from Kaggle Models, tokens/sec or passages/sec at ~150 tokens, which quantisation path worked (bitsandbytes NF4, GPTQ/AWQ, something else), and whether the expert routing makes it much slower than a dense 8B in practice.
